p: Same woman as reference (A-Fang, ponytail, pink shirt), holding a preschool enrollment flyer, her toddler son holding her hand, smiling with relief, outside a bright kindergarten gate.
Same man as reference (Jiahao, glasses, pink cardigan), small private kindergarten owner, standing alone in the doorway of an empty classroom with tiny chairs, worried.
Same man as reference (Jiahao), proudly standing under a newly hung blank signboard at his kindergarten gate, parents arriving behind him.
Same young woman as reference (Teacher Xiaoyun, bob hair, cardigan), sitting on a tiny chair in an after-hours classroom, looking quietly at a pay slip in her hands.
Several happy Taiwanese parents cheering and hugging at a public kindergarten lottery in a school hall, raising arms, confetti-free, simple.
Same woman as reference (A-Fang), holding a small waitlist slip, turning away from a school hall with her toddler, walking toward a private preschool, quiet resignation.
Same woman as reference (A-Fang), at home at a dining table, sitting beside her young son who attends online class on a tablet, wearing face masks nearby, cozy.
Same man as reference (Zhihao, lanyard), at an office desk with two tall stacks of paperwork and two monitors, a cold lunchbox half-eaten, colleague's empty chair beside him, face mask on chin.
Same man as reference (Zhihao), in a small rented room, opening an official envelope with relief, a single bed and a small window.
Same man as reference (Zhihao), late at night alone in an office, desk lamp on, still working, two piles of work, dark window.
Same woman as reference (A-Fang), at home on the floor playing blocks with her toddler, afternoon light, calm.
Same woman as reference (A-Fang), alone at a kitchen table looking at an empty staff ID lanyard and a resignation letter, toddler toys on the floor.
Same woman as reference (A-Fang), unhurried at 6pm picking up her child at a kindergarten gate, child running to her, sunset.
Same woman as reference (Yijun, teacher apron), at dusk in a kindergarten corridor, holding the hands of three small children waiting for parents, wall clock area, tired.
Happy parents dropping off small children at a public kindergarten during summer vacation, sun, cicada season, open gate.
Same woman as reference (Yijun), standing in an empty summer classroom holding a returned leave request form, a plane ticket on the desk, quiet.
A young newlywed Taiwanese couple holding up the keys to their new apartment, standing in front of a new social housing building, joyful.
Same man as reference (Zhihao), alone at the very end of a long queue at a service counter, holding a number ticket, single, patient.
Same woman as reference (the office worker mother with tote bag), leaving the office at noon with her bag, smiling, a half-day leave, walking toward the door.

Same woman as reference (Lao Yan, glasses, dark sweater, silver ring), sitting at a night office desk between two very tall stacks of files, a photocopied draft bill document tucked between the stacks, camera on the desk, looking at the viewer.
Still life on a desk: a desk calendar page with one date circled in pink pencil, and two identical simple silver rings next to it. Close-up, square.
A small photo frame on a desk showing two women's hands holding each other, both wearing identical silver rings, warm colors. Square.
A smartphone lying on a desk at night, screen showing a chat bubble (no readable text), a cold dinner plate under a cover beside it. Square.
A fridge door with a single clinic appointment card held by a magnet, slightly curled, next to a photo of two women's hands. Square.
A photo frame on a desk showing only one woman's hand with a silver ring, the other half of the photo empty. Square.
